metadata.title: Defense-tech neoprimes: Palantir, Anduril, Shield AI, and In-Q-Tel capital

entities.name: Palantir
entities.notes: Gotham / Foundry / AIP. Public company. Early In-Q-Tel seed is company history, not a current-control claim. Maven Smart System is Pentagon AI targeting software (program-of-record reporting 2026). Government is a large revenue share. Relocation of HQ (Denver to Miami, 2026 press) is incidental.

entities.name: Anduril
entities.notes: Palmer Luckey / Trae Stephens. Lattice C2 plus hardware (sensors, CUAS, autonomous aircraft). Army TITAN production orders (2026 press: Palantir software prime, Anduril hardware share). Valuation/raise figures in 2025-26 press are market-color, not contract facts.

entities.name: Shield_AI
entities.notes: Hivemind autonomy stack (AI pilot) and V-BAT UAV. Company-stated selection as mission-autonomy layer on Anduril YFQ-44A Fury CCA. 2024 Palantir partnership reporting for Hivemind + V-BAT. Tracker C-UAS licensed to L3Harris (company, Sep 2026). Dual-use in the Privacy International sense (military UAV also sold for border/maritime surveillance) is a product-class fact, not an inferred intent.

entities.name: In_Q_Tel
entities.notes: CIA-chartered nonprofit VC (2000). Strategic, not return-maximizing. Public Palantir seed is the canonical IC-capital exhibit. Public Substrate backer (2025). Backing is a relevance signal, not operational control of portfolio companies.

entities.name: Lattice
entities.notes: Anduril command-and-control / sensor-fusion software. NATO E-ACCS reporting (2026) pairs Lattice with Palantir in alliance C2 awards.

entities.name: Hivemind
entities.notes: Shield AI onboard autonomy. GPS-denied flight is a company/demo claim. Distinct from Palantir Maven (ISR targeting software, not an autopilot).

entities.name: Maven
entities.notes: DoD Project Maven lineage; Palantir Maven Smart System. Public program-of-record / targeting-support reporting. Not a finding about any named strike.

entities.name: Golden_Dome
entities.notes: US missile-defense initiative. Reuters/WSJ (Mar 2026) cite unnamed sources that Anduril and Palantir are in a consortium writing C2 software. Not a published award notice in this block. Grade: moderate / alleged.

entities.name: Founders_Fund
entities.notes: Thiel-founded VC. Public Palantir history; Anduril (Trae Stephens is a partner). Capital adjacency, not a hive mind.
